justification.text: The divisor `N` is zero only at N = 0, one term of a sequence whose `Tendsto ... atTop` is unchanged by finitely many terms; and `delta N` is positive for every N (it is the infimum of a finite nonempty set of positive reals — the subsets of {1..N} are finitely many and the empty set contributes 1 — so the minimum is attained and nonzero), so `-log (delta N) / N` is the informal text's own `-log δ(N) / N → c`.

delta N is the infimum of the nonzero values |1 - Σ_{n∈A} 1/n| over the finitely many A ⊆ {1..N}; the set is finite and nonempty (A = ∅ gives 1), so the infimum is a minimum of positive reals and delta N > 0. The log is never taken of a non-positive value.
`Set.Ioo 0 1` is the docstring's 'for some constant c ∈ (0,1)': the open interval, both endpoints excluded, as the problem states.
